style: 3D animated satire, deadpan slapstick; penguin fills two thirds of frame height

subject.character: ONE neat emperor penguin accountant, black tailcoat under a rich fur coat, fat wallet inside, bow tie; same face, fully serious

second_characters: ONE big tusked walrus, travel bag on a shoulder strap, jars clinking in it, burner hooked on it

props.kit: cupping jars; gas burner, blue flame; four wicks taped on the penguin's back
props.leaflets: white leaflets printed ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ in black Cyrillic

environment: small ice floe, dense pressure ridges with icicles, deep blue water
lighting: polar sun rim behind-left, gold; cold blue rim behind-right; flares on every move
motion_rule: camera orbits, new shot size every beat, never parked

audio.delivery: flat low male voice, native, no accent
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once in its beat, no pause after Я; after 4.75 rotor roar, clinks, pops, no words

timeline.a: medium low, orbit left: the penguin in his fur coat struts briskly along the ridge; the walrus bounds after, bag bouncing
waist, orbit right: still strutting, he whips a fat wallet from the coat, flicks out a bundle, tosses it over his shoulder; the walrus catches it mid-bound, crams it in the bag
low medium, orbit left: he trips on flat ice, flings two more bundles; the walrus snatches one from the air, flips the other in with a tusk
medium, counter-arc: the walrus yanks the coat off by the collar; he spins out of it like a top, four wicks on his back
waist, orbit to his side: he flops on his belly, slides; the walrus rams the coat into the bag on the run
medium, arc: he belly-slides under it; the walrus swings the roaring burner off the strap, flame sweeps over him as he passes, two wicks catch
low medium, swift orbit: helicopter skids drop to top edge; he is knocked flat, belly-spins; the walrus slaps jar one onto a lit wick, pop
waist, arc, leaflets pour: one slaps his face, he peels it off, reads it, eyes bulging, beak shut tight; the walrus shakes his head, a leaflet stuck on his tusks
medium, arc, his face to camera: he hops at the pop; the walrus flops beside him, lights the last two wicks, slaps jar two on, pop
medium, arc left: he scrambles off, flippers windmilling, jars clinking; the walrus hooks the burner on the strap, bounds after, slaps jars three and four on mid-leap, pop, pop
waist, arc right: he whips round, a back jar clanks the walrus's tusk; the walrus reels, the bag bursts, bundles and the coat scatter
low medium, arc: he trips on flat ice again, flops onto the coat; the walrus heaves up, scoops bundles to his chest

waist, short arc: he glides on the fur coat in a curve across frame, head raised, face turned to camera, four jars on his back clinking, still gliding at the end; the walrus belly-flops after, a bundle in his teeth, bumps the penguin's tail

must_appear: 0.30 wallet, bundle caught; 2.00 coat yanked; 4.75 skids, jar; 5.45 ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ; 6.90 jars mid-leap; 7.70 bag bursts; 9.35 glide on coat, face to camera, four jars
negative_prompt: static camera, aerial shot, locked-off shots, subtitles, watermark, labels, digits, duplicate penguins, two walruses, floating jars, hero seen only from behind, a repeated word, speech after 4.9, English speech, foreign accent, burnt feathers, coat on fire, penguin standing still, penguin waiting, walrus placing money or jars carefully
